newsitem.title: UK: Grand Met gains on Merrill "buy" advice.
newsitem.headline: Grand Met gains on Merrill "buy" advice.

text.p: Grand Metropolitan Plc shares put on 5p to 500p in relatively brisk volume on Thursday, after Merrill Lynch reiterated its "buy" recommendation on the stock based on technical considerations.
Technical analyst Luise Kliem said the alcoholic beverage sector has started to rally this year, having found long term support from the 1987 relative low.
"This looks like the beginning of a long term turn around," she said.
Kliem said Grand Metropolitan looks particularly attractive.
"There's a longer term chart objective of 650p if resistance at 500p gives way in the near term, which means the stock closing about 500p at least a couple of times," she said.
"There's resistance at 520p, but the stock's relative charts are now suggesting a long term upturn versus the market," Kliem said.
"Grand Met will weather FTSE corrections very well and do very well in rallies," she said.
